description:
A graduate student imported a batch of references, and Zotero defaulted everything to 'Journal Article'. You need to fix four specific items that are incorrectly categorized.

Task:
1. Locate 'Attention Is All You Need' (Vaswani et al.) and change its Item Type to 'Conference Paper'.
2. Locate 'Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition' (He et al.) and change its Item Type to 'Conference Paper'.
3. Locate 'ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks' (Krizhevsky et al.) and change its Item Type to 'Conference Paper'.
4. Locate 'The Mathematical Theory of Communication' (Shannon) and change its Item Type to 'Book'.

Do not change the item type of any other papers. You may encounter a confirmation dialog warning about field changes when switching types; verify the change is appropriate and proceed.

targets.title_fragment: Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition
